score_protocol.reference: Normalized mean of 34 normalized reference-face embeddings; reference images and centroid omitted.
score_protocol.image_selection: Largest detected face by bounding-box area
score_protocol.missing_detection: Missing, never zero likeness or successful zero bleed
score_protocol.comparison: Excess subtracts the no-adapter score for the exact prompt, seed and render setup
score_protocol.limitation: Face identity similarity does not measure garment adherence, overall quality or broad model preservation.

illustrations.operation: Decode native image to RGB, resize, compose labels, encode JPEG with no source metadata
illustrations.measurement_scope: All scores belong to original native PNGs, not the JPEG illustrations.

reproducibility: Synthetic demo and solver tests are runnable. Historical image-score recomputation requires private adapters and reference set, which are excluded.
